---
title: "Batch the document lock queries of bulk operations by the adapter's parameter limit"
description: "Drop when the pinned release keeps the bulk document lock queries within D1's limit of 100 bound parameters."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.3. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

A bulk delete of more than a few documents fails on D1 with "D1_ERROR: too
many SQL variables". Before it deletes, the operation finds and removes the
documents' locks with one query on payload-locked-documents each, matching
document.value against every id. document is a relationship to every
lockable collection, so the SQL adapters compare each collection's column
with the whole id list, and the query binds one parameter per document per
collection, plus one for the join. D1 accepts 100, so a site with 23
collections can't delete 5 documents at once, and an editor who selects a
page of media in the admin and deletes it gets an error. The lock check runs
before any document is deleted, so nothing is deleted.

When the adapter sets limitedBoundParameters, as the D1 adapter does,
getLockedDocumentIds and deleteDocumentLocks now split the ids into batches
that keep each query within 100 bound parameters. Other adapters keep one
query. This patch requires d1-file-lookup-bound-parameters, which adds
limitedBoundParameters.

- **Patch:** `d1-document-lock-bound-parameters`, committed as `fix(payload): batch the document lock queries of bulk operations by the adapter's parameter limit`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `e2e suite (database.spec.ts bulk delete test)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0018-fix-payload-batch-the-document-lock-queries-of-bulk-.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0018-fix-payload-batch-the-document-lock-queries-of-bulk-.patch)
